description: EXAMPLE capability catalog. ConstraintSets reference PROCESSOR IDS; whether a processor is legal for a route is a fact, and facts about acquirers do not belong in a merchant's policy document. This file is a fixture: it mirrors the six processors of spikes/0003-bandit-vs-table so that a constraint result and a reward result can be read side by side. In the implementation this is produced by onboarding and served from the state store (#13), hashed into every audit record. 2026.09.2 adds the three contract facts ADR-0009 R66 and ADR-0010 R75 require and the 2026.09.1 fixture did not carry (max_response_ms, key_lifetime_ms, auth_fee_minor); ADR-0011 section 7 put that change in the ticket that first consumes the facts, with the scenario re-pin in the same PR (ADR-0012). Capability and economics are unchanged from 2026.09.1, so no result that depends only on those moves.
currencies_note: currencies = currencies the acquirer will settle in; markets = issuing regions accepted; three_ds = 3DS/EMV 3-D Secure flow available; acquirer_country/region drive domestic and residency rules.
contract_facts_note: max_response_ms = M in ADR-0009 R66: after M a conforming processor has a final, queryable state for every request it received, so M bounds the probe loop and retires an ambiguous timeout. Values are clamp(10 x the declared latency p95, 3000, 15000) -- the rule spikes/0010-idempotency/protocol.py derived M with (contract_max_response_ms), carried here as a catalog fact so the protocol and the fact base agree instead of the fixture inventing a second rule. The 3 s floor stops a fast processor being voided while still alive; the 15 s ceiling keeps M inside ADR-0009's route-class resolution windows (oneoff_cnp 30 s). key_lifetime_ms >= M (R66): the persisted idempotency key stays queryable for the whole retry horizon and past it in the ledger, which ADR-0009 section 2 makes a #13 concern (the ledger table in the journal file); 24 h is the horizon the fixtures use. auth_fee_minor is the 3DS server's per-authentication-session fee in minor units, charged by path (ADR-0010 R75): 2 for the five 3DS-capable processors -- the value spikes/0011-sca-friction measured with -- and 0 for echo, which has no 3DS capability and can never incur one. In production all three are onboarding-recorded contract facts, not derived ones.
